facts.fact: The Eswatini Revenue Service says in a 3 February 2025 presentation that customs declaration data is automatically exchanged with the South African Revenue Service, and that it built its electronic certificate of origin on existing ASYCUDA World infrastructure.

systems.country_label: Electronic certificate of origin (SADC May 2021, COMESA November 2024)

SWZ.note: The exchange with SARS is with one neighbour and the e-CO is an origin certificate, so no regional exchange of declaration or transit data is stated.
